title: Implement Robust Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters because it will allow yantraverse to handle complex request bodies, including JSON and form data, which is essential for building robust APIs. It will add support for parsing request bodies in middleware and route handlers. This will improve the overall performance and reliability of the framework
testCases: Test error handling for invalid request bodies
acceptance: The feature is accepted when request bodies are correctly parsed and errors are properly handled for various scenarios, including JSON and form data
reason: This feature is technically justified because it addresses a critical need for handling complex request data, which is a common requirement in modern web applications
